and --maps not reaching the description store-root lookups. This review re-reads the landed diff commit by

environment; nothing here ran a transport or a live serve.

module's existing invalid-token error naming the full-token form for a series-letterless token, normalised_shot
keeps bare digits for cache directory names, and machine_map.py threads search_path into resolve_store_root at
both lookups that dropped it; cli.py:81-88 and the README name the full token.
